What a GB of RAM really costs on a VPS

Answer: Across 28 verified VPS plans from 12 providers (checked through 2026-10-31), list price per GB of RAM ranges from $1.21/GB/mo (OVHcloud VPS-3) to $10.00/GB/mo (AWS Lightsail Linux 0.5 GB) — 8.3× apart; the median is $5.00/GB. Hetzner CX23 and Hetzner CX33 would rank lower per GB but are sold out as of 2026-10-31, so they are left out of these figures. Per vCPU, OVHcloud VPS-3 is cheapest at $2.42/vCPU/mo vs a $6.50 median. Intro prices hide renewal jumps of up to +85% (Hostinger VPS KVM 1).

Intro vs renewal

Plans sold with an introductory (first-term) price. Term/prepay discounts (e.g. OVH 12-mo) are shown in the ranking tables as “12-mo …” and are not counted as renewal traps here. Ratios use the no-commitment/renewal price.

Method

  • Rows: every verified plan in the VPSLedger ledger with published vCPU, RAM and price (28 of 34; unverified rows excluded).
  • Price = monthly list / renewal price from the provider’s own page or official API; EUR converted at ECB 1.1188 USD/EUR (2026-10-26).
  • Excludes IPv4, backups, egress overage and taxes — use the TCO calculator for the full bill. How we calculate this.

Questions

Which VPS has the cheapest price per GB of RAM?

OVHcloud VPS-3 at $1.21/GB/mo list price, as of 2026-10-31.

What is the median VPS price per GB RAM?

$5.00/GB/mo across 28 verified plans; median per vCPU is $6.50/mo.

Does this include IPv4, backups and bandwidth?

No — this study ranks list (renewal) price only. The VPSLedger TCO calculator adds IPv4, backups and egress overage.

Can I reuse the data?

Yes, CC BY 4.0. Download http://localhost:4173/api/study-vps-price-per-gb.csv and link http://localhost:4173/study/vps-price-per-gb-ram.
